name: swim-coach
description: Use ChatGPT as the prescribing swim coach with validated versioned cycles, direct workouts, Garmin, sync, and feedback commands.

interface.shortDescription: Prescribe validated cycles and publish swim training
interface.longDescription: Use ChatGPT as the primary prescribing coach to review swims and goals, author and approve rolling training cycles, adapt future weeks from deterministic evidence, save or edit workouts, publish them directly to Garmin, synchronize activities, and record feedback. The backend validates and executes the prescription without generating sports content.
defaultPrompt: Use Swim Coach to review my latest swim.
Use Swim Coach to show my swimming goal progress.
Use Swim Coach to explain why my latest swim is missing.
Use Swim Coach to adapt and save my next swim.
Use Swim Coach to publish my workout to Garmin.
Use Swim Coach to record my post-swim feedback.
Use Swim Coach to create an eight-week adaptive cycle and plan my next swim week.
Use Swim Coach to delete my planned workout everywhere.
